title: Customer request classification
lesson: Name the exact decision and the text to classify.

category.instructions: Classify the main purpose of the customer message.

criteria.billing: Payments, duplicate charges, invoices and requests to return money.
criteria.technical_support: An existing product feature fails, crashes or does not work.
criteria.product_feedback: Suggestions for a new feature or a change to product behaviour.
criteria.general_enquiry: Questions about opening hours, contact details or general service information, without a billing problem, broken feature or feature suggestion.

cases.state: Please refund the duplicate charge on my account.
Where can I download the invoice for last month?
The app closes every time I open a saved document.
The export button no longer responds when I click it.
Please add a dark mode to the dashboard.
I would like an option to schedule reports every Monday.
What time does your support office open?
Where can I find your postal address?
The app works well, but you charged me twice. Can you reverse one charge?
I cancelled last month but received another subscription invoice.
I am not asking for a new feature: the search box stopped working today.
Since the update, uploading a photograph displays an error.
Nothing is broken. Could you add spreadsheet export in a future release?
The current colour scheme works, but I suggest offering more themes.
Do you offer telephone support on Saturdays?
Which email address should I use for general questions?
